author: Codex /root/permission_lifecycle_design; critical architecture and primary-source review
candidate_name: 源读取退休驱动的方向许可交接（read-retirement permission handoff）

executive_decision.retain: 保留为生命周期合同候选：当一项COPY的源区间已不可能再被读取且所有已承诺读取完成时，关闭旧读许可并发布源页可复用证书；该COPY的目的写继续完成，不等待无关SID。
executive_decision.new_action: 将可信DMA描述符给出的有限访问集合、真实R完成和IOMMU权限门绑定成原子交接；源READ权限先消耗，目的WRITE提交义务独立退休。
executive_decision.not_novel_by_itself: 按范围失效、版本标签、最后引用计数、方向权限、批处理和只等待相关请求均已有先例。尤其PTX8.0已有source-read-only completion，所以“源完成和整COPY完成分开”本身也不能算创新。
executive_decision.performance_result: 当前手例中预排source-complete选择性撤销能复现数值；该控制已加入相同新合同，故它否决额外复杂版本/调度算法的必要性，不是已发表前作覆盖合同的证据。合同自身的论文贡献须准确原文与端到端实现/成本结果判断。
executive_decision.ranking: 新发现PTX源read-only completion准确前例后，降为需重设计的条件式生命周期候选，不建议直接以源完成事件作为论文主贡献或进入RTL。IOMMU授权耗尽与全别名可回收证书仍是需要准确比较的合同问题。
executive_decision.reframe: 真正需要判定的是：有真实动态、多源、页内交错访问时，是否能用压缩的源访问退休证书，在少于完整按请求表的成本下，精确关闭已消费的授权并让下一代继续；不能只证明新标签比全局fence快。

primary_sources.title: rIOMMU: Efficient IOMMU for I/O Devices that Employ Ring Buffers
primary_sources.read_sections: §4 Design, Figures 9–11, Applicability and Limitations, pp.6–9 of PDF; web lines576–910
primary_sources.coverage: Flat per-ring mappings, one cached current mapping and optional next, direction/bounds, end-of-burst invalidation. Its limitation is predictable map/unmap order, NOT a blanket ban on out-of-order valid DMA accesses.
primary_sources.gap: Inspected mechanism does not bind last source-R retirement of a memory-to-memory COPY to independent WRITE lifetime. That gap is a hypothesis about contract capability, not proof of performance novelty.

primary_sources.title: Utilizing the IOMMU Scalably
primary_sources.coverage: Per-PTE reference counts, separate read/write identity-mapping regions, per-core deferred flush queues; quarantines IOVA/page-table memory until invalidation.
primary_sources.boundary: Direction reference counts and deferred invalidation are already covered. Delayed physical-page protection cannot be silently accepted as strict reclaim semantics.

primary_sources.title: DMAAUTH: A Lightweight Pointer Integrity-based Secure Architecture to Defeat DMA Attacks
primary_sources.coverage: Hardware pointer authentication and per-mapping bounds/permissions/identifier, with OS dma_unmap changing identity and clearing R/W before ordinary mapping cleanup.
primary_sources.boundary: Immediate permission gate plus generation identity is covered in principle; candidate must specifically justify autonomous actual-progress attenuation and independent source/write lifetimes. No security superiority over DMAAUTH claimed.

primary_sources.title: Fast and Safe IO Memory Protection
primary_sources.coverage: Contiguous IOVA allocation, retain valid page-table caches during strict leaf invalidation, range batching.
primary_sources.boundary: Do not claim merely retaining unaffected PTcache or fewer CQ entries as novel; give F&S-compatible controls the same locality and safe cache preservation.

primary_sources.title: RISC-V IOMMU specification, In-memory queue interface
primary_sources.read_sections: IOMMU Command-queue Fence commands, web lines95–116; IOTINVAL context/address semantics
primary_sources.coverage: IOFENCE.C orders preceding CQ commands; PR/PW cover already-processed device reads/writes at a global ordering point. Requests not yet seen by IOMMU require interconnect-specific handling.
primary_sources.boundary: Custom source-retirement certificates must not be advertised as standard global IOFENCE.C completion. Targeted cache invalidation is distinct from actual data retirement.

primary_sources.title: NVIDIA PTX ISA, cp.async.bulk.wait_group{.read}
primary_sources.version: Introduced PTX8.0; verified official8.1/8.4 archive and current9.x text
primary_sources.coverage: The .read modifier waits only for source reads of committed async groups. Ordinary wait includes destination writes and visibility. Thus source-consumed versus whole-copy-completed is already an explicit production ISA capability.
primary_sources.boundary: The inspected operation does not specify multi-SID IOMMU permission revocation, all-alias physical page reclaim certificates or custom per-epoch IOTLB drain. Those remain separate obligations, not automatically novel because domain differs.

source_evidence.fact: CQ decodes address/context-qualified IOTINVAL and emits invalidation; this is not a data-transaction retirement handshake.
Line362 explicitly TODO PR/PW R/W-counter support. Existing IOFENCE branch handles completion store, wired interrupt and ATS fence; cannot use its completion as proof native DMA data drained.
Context/address match invalidates cached translations; translation fills may later update entries. Need epoch revalidation for a fill started before close if dynamic remap is added.

Native two permission lifecycles. policy_quiet checks TL/walker/response storage and invalidations; it is not proof all payload data R/W/B retired. Nonblock path invalidation cancellation also needs contract review.
Real source R handshake and last-of-burst visible at245,269–273. A burst RLAST is not automatically descriptor last source use; descriptor bounds/cursor and all accepted bursts must be checked.
B completion is separately exposed; WRITE ownership and errors may remain after last R. W acceptance or WLAST alone cannot be called copy completion.

scenario.real_workload: CPU producer reuses bounded staging pages for repeated copies to downstream consumers with uneven destination B latency, while another DMA has long outstanding source reads. Small descriptors/cyclic staging occur in streaming I/O; platform can express finite contiguous COPYs, but no measured application trace establishes frequency yet.
scenario.why_existing_state_is_too_coarse: Whole-COPY completion keeps source ownership until unrelated WRITE response. A standard global PR fence can also wait on another SID; a range/context drain removes that part, hence is mandatory strong control.
scenario.scope: Trusted on-SoC iDMA descriptor frontends; non-ATS normal coherent memory; finite source intervals. Hostile external requesters require an authenticated source of descriptor/epoch identity, not untrusted AXI user bits.
scenario.start_state: All methods begin from the same input descriptors, producer dependencies, permission checks and empty work state. Pregrant/lookahead are allowed equally. No forced pending destination fault or artificially limited outstanding count.

precise_contract.objects: A read lease names (SID, mapping context, descriptor, generation, source IOVA interval, successful read grant). A separate write obligation names original destination and completion. Eight read-lease records allow active+prepared leases for four DMA streams; they are new storage, not existing eight request heads.
precise_contract.linearization: At the trusted frontend, reserve the finite source-byte range and immutable lease cookie before first AR VALID. AR VALID is held unchanged until handshake. No old-generation AR may be newly created after its full finite source set has been committed or close accepted.
precise_contract.retirement: A lease can produce READ_RETIRED only after issue_closed AND every committed/read-offer obligation has a real successful last R handshake at the trusted consumer or acknowledged terminal-error drain. No uncounted spill, retry or request may remain.
precise_contract.effect: Close old read gate and generation before publishing READ_RETIRED; software/producer may reuse physical source only when all mappings/read leases to that page have retired and CPU coherence requirements hold. Destination permission remains tied to its own admitted transaction and B completion.
precise_contract.next_generation: Same IOVA+same PA staging reuse needs a new descriptor generation and data-ready release before opening reads. Different PA remap requires PTE store visibility, epoch-qualified fills/cache entry or fresh IOVA. A next-generation mapping cannot simply bypass the native PTE grant.
precise_contract.no_semantic_cheat: A trusted source-consumed event is a new API, not a full COPY success. Errors may invalidate the destination while source is already safely consumed. Buffer ownership/reuse is not physical source copy retention. On overlap/in-place DMA, all alias obligations must be represented or early reuse disabled.

algorithm_pseudocode: PREPARE(desc): check ordinary mapping permissions; allocate lease and result ownership; record finite non-overlapping source range; do not change native permission semantics.

BEFORE_FIRST_AR_VALID: if source generation active, address==next_issue_cursor and burst lies within range, reserve immutable (lease,gen,length) cookie and advance committed cursor; otherwise fault/backpressure. Reservation lives through held VALID.
AR_HANDSHAKE: mark physical request in flight; retain cookie in paid ID/order scoreboard. Do not cancel a held offer on a revoke.
R_HANDSHAKE: charge returned bytes to the matching reserved request; mark errors sticky; retire request only after actual RLAST. Do not count merely visible RVALID.

CLOSE: disallow all new reservations in old lease; wait for pre-existing held offers/requests and suppressed-refill obligations to settle. Emergency revoke may force fault/reset recovery but never emits a safe-reuse certificate early.
IF issue_closed && all_reserved_read_obligations_retired && no_untracked_alias: atomically disable old read gate; publish READ_RETIRED(desc,gen,status). Do not wait on unrelated SID or destination B.
REARM: only trusted producer data-ready + successful ordinary mapping/permission state opens next lease. Generation cannot wrap while stale identities/results exist.
B_HANDSHAKE: retire original write obligation and eventually report whole COPY success/error independently.

cost_model.purpose: Explicit conservative logical state proposal for 4 streams,8 leases,8 read obligations,16 IOTLB entries. Not a synthesis result, not full-platform area. 64-bit addresses are chosen interface widths, not asserted native PAddrWidth.
cost_model.lease_sum: 337 bits each; allocate48 bytes ×8 =384 bytes. Extra PA snapshots behave as eight additional translation-capacity records; controls receive equivalent storage/use.
cost_model.read_obligation_scoreboard: 8 × (slot3 + gen16 + length13 + error1)=264 bits, conservatively padded8×40=320bits=40bytes. Native IDs/order storage itself remains charged in platform baseline.
cost_model.certificate_queue: 8 × (slot3 + gen16 + status2 + direction1)=176bits, padded8×32=256bits=32bytes; backpressure keeps retired state until accepted, cannot discard certificate.
cost_model.generation_for_dynamic_remap: 16 IOTLB entries×16bits=32bytes;2 TL lifecycle records×16bits=4bytes; same-PA-only variant may omit these only after showing no mapping/permission cache ambiguity.
additional_costs: A request identity must cross the DMA/bank/spill boundary; need generation/cookie width in every stage that can hold an AR or result, including held VALID.494bytes excludes unknown pipeline stage replication, so it is not a total implemented count.

At least one request reserve and one response-retire update per cycle or explicit arbitration. Dual-port/banked state and forwarding are required when AR/R affect same record in one cycle. All simultaneous events must be serialized without losing increments.

Eight bounds/context/generation candidates need comparators if associative; use trusted frontend slot index to avoid wide CAM, but that adds frontend index provenance and routing. At least one added admission/retirement pipeline cycle is budgeted by examples.
Existing32 W words+spills are unchanged; no payload buffer is added. Long stalled W that prevents last R limits early reuse naturally.
CPU producer data-ready and mapping setup are still paid. No claim of zero software work or zero CQ costs for arbitrary remaps.
Completing native PR/PW data ordering is a separate common baseline correctness cost. Custom per-lease retirement needs additional matching counters/ownership even after that correction.
cost_model.critical_path: Keep range/generation check before first offered VALID using registered reservation. R/B handshake counters cannot combinationally select a different held request. Pipeline latency and ports must be matched in controls.
cost_model.budget_comparators: Give alternatives the same 8 metadata/PA records,8 actual heads,32 W words, existing2 TL lifecycles, prefetch/lookahead resources and producer information. No 4-free-walker assumption.

request_accounting_example.data_path_common: 3 descriptors, each64bytes:3 AR bursts/24 R beats,3 AW bursts/24 W beats,3 B responses;6 ordinary source/destination permission decisions. All declared data bytes and full B completion identical.
request_accounting_example.candidate: 3 source leases installed/programmed,3 source-retirement certificates (V1,A1,V2), producer-ready/rearm event forV2; no source PTE change if same mapping backing is retained under authoritative finite-use READ gate. Those installs/notifications are real control traffic, not free. Different-PA remap invokes ordinary mapping work or separately charged qualified overlay.
request_accounting_example.software_selective: Source completion notification forV1; old PTE clear+ordering,one targeted IOTINVAL andone completion/fence operation before reuse;one new PTE install/ordering forV2. At least32bytes CQ descriptors plusoptional4byte completion store forthe one reuse point, in addition to descriptor/producer work. Implementation of selective data drain is not native IOFENCE PR and must be added/charged.
request_accounting_example.global_PR: Same IOTINVAL+IOFENCE command count and PTE work as strict software path, but PR waits earlier A source reads; this is a wait-scope effect, not fewer useful-copy bytes.
request_accounting_example.whole_COPY: Same strict mapping control atV1 B completion, with no need for new source-complete event. Its larger source lifetime may be acceptable if staging storage is abundant.
request_accounting_example.prearmed_control: Same3 lease/condition records and source-retirement notifications as candidate; can fold cursor/progress from trusted DMA source metadata. It is likely the preferred implementation ofthe contract, and may use less than candidate conservative494bytes. No reason to build both as separate near-identical RTL algorithms.
request_accounting_example.fresh_IOVA: Next source PTE/IOVA can be prepared early;old mapping close/retirement still required forphysical source reuse. Strict unmap uses CQ work; adding prearmed gate reproduces candidate contract. Pre-reservation needsone extra4KiB IOVA (not necessarily extraphysicalpage),one8byte leaf PTE and one cache entry ifretained; page-table allocation boundary maycost4KiB table, so useequal same-table addresses forminimum-cost control.
request_accounting_example.important: Latency constants20/4/96 are illustrative schedule inputs including assigned preparation/service costs, not derived from raw transaction counts. Real model must independently charge metadata MMIO/CQ/PTE memory arbitration and CPU notification;startup20 must not be copied toRTL as measured number.

complete_controls.name: Global strict source revoke
complete_controls.rule: At source-consumed notification update source PTE, IOTINVAL target, IOFENCE.PR for all already-processed reads; all prior CQ/memory work paid. With no early source event uses whole-COPY completion; these are separate rows.

complete_controls.name: Directional source completion + range/context drain
complete_controls.rule: Use identical source progress notifications, close only old source range before new AR, invalidate only its mappings, count and drain only old accepted source R; unrelated SID and destination B continue. CPU-triggered and prearmed hardware forms both compared.

complete_controls.name: Prearmed source-complete revoke
complete_controls.rule: Before COPY, program condition last source read retirement => close old READ gate and publish completion. One same-budget record binds expected interval+counter to mapping; no whole-COPY wait. This concrete simple control reproduces candidate basic hand example exactly; not claimed published exact protocol.
complete_controls.classification: 这是具体可执行的同合同简单实现；不能引用成已发表先例。它检验复杂候选是否多此一举。

complete_controls.name: rIOMMU ring plus early source event
complete_controls.rule: Give source and destination separate ring/permission entries, retain valid accesses out of order, invalidate relevant ring at burst end. For short one-descriptor burst explicit source invalidation remains; do not incorrectly assume valid out-of-order accesses unsupported.

complete_controls.name: Fresh IOVA / alternate context
complete_controls.rule: Prepare next mapping at a distinct IOVA or generation/context; reserve equally many active/retiring records and all PTE/translation costs. Old source must still be closed/drained before physical page reuse. On editable iDMA descriptors, same-IOVA versioning alone has no unique advantage.
complete_controls.classification: 仅新IOVA没有source-consumed证据。数值相同的行明确额外加入与候选同一prearmed close合同；不允许偷换为freshIOVA本身获得早期physical reuse。

complete_controls.name: Persistent mappings / two staging pages
complete_controls.rule: Allow when same protection and memory budget hold. Permanent old READ permission is not strict revocation; two pages may remove producer wait at added page cost, which must be matched with candidate budget. F&S-style preserved PTcache and WRITE lookahead apply equally.

complete_controls.name: 已有read-only completion语义＋权限门＋定向排空
complete_controls.rule: 按PTX已有思路为COPY暴露可信源read-only完成，将该事件接入DMAAUTH式身份/READ权限关闭并只排空对应源请求；针对物理共享页给每alias独立闭合状态/引用，最后alias退休再发回收证书。此为明确可执行组合对照，不声称已有一篇论文完整实现该组合。基础单源手例与候选相同；新规则必须在一个具体动态状态上区别于此组合，或证明完整成本优势。
complete_controls.classification: 组件分别有准确前作；完整组合是本轮明确提出的强对照。单纯没有单篇同名论文不是充分创新理由。

quantitative_hand_example.classification: Analytical schedule only; invented latency parameters for an explicit possible event order, not measured/RTL cycles. Shows actual source-lifetime capability and exact strong-control reproduction.
assumptions: Three64-byteCOPYs: V1,V2 and A1; each uses8 true8-byte R beats and8 W beats plus one B. Same source page reused byV2 after producer updates64bytes; other page bytes have no active leases. No V/A physical aliases.

Common prepare/ordinary permissions startup20 cycles. V1 last source R at84, V1 B at180; A1 last source R at276 and B at340. B delay represents downstream completion, not invented payload capacity. Existing32Wwords sufficient for these short copies; all8 head slots available.

After safe-source event S, producer fill20 + new read-grant/rearm4 + V2 fullCOPY96, so V2 B=S+120. Sideband/certificate propagation4 included. Scheduling/resource availability for V2 is assumed and must be checked in actual backend; all controls use identical conditions.

CPU response latencyL=20 in software rows is illustrative, not measured. Strong prearmed control removes this cost too. All permitted READ/WRITE checks and data bytes equal; A completion340 unchanged.

rows.method: source event + standard global PR waits earlier A read
prearmed source-complete selective revoke, equal budget
fresh IOVA plus same prearmed selective close, equal budget

quantitative_hand_example.metrics: 192 useful copied bytes; candidate versus global-PR throughput ratio400/340=1.17647 in this possible event schedule. Candidate versus same-contract prearmed implementation ratio1.0; this proves no extra complex scheduling advantage. It does not settle whether the common newly exposed source-retirement contract is prior art.
adjacent_counterexamples: Let A1 also read the same physical source page until276. Safe physical reuse cannot occur at88; last alias still needs old content. Candidate must wait, just like reference-counted selective control.
Let V1 destination pressure prevent final source R until nearly its B completion. Source/whole-copy separation disappears; added metadata/control latency may lose.

Let the workload legitimately reread an earlier source offset after a later burst. Monotone consumption invalidates required access; finite-use proof fails and ordinary persistent/range control wins unless richer interval metadata is paid.
Let descriptors be freely rewritten and fresh IOVA preparation fit equal records. New-epoch address aliasing is merely another representation; cannot claim unique throughput from it.

fresh_IOVA_without_contract.assumption: Use original whole-COPY success as only trusted source done event; next map ready does not prove old source finished. This illustrative row includessame20+4 safe close latency; freshIOVA improves neither source evidence nor source-memory lifetime byitself.

correctness_obligations: Never reclaim merely because no current ARVALID: account for all descriptors/held AR offers, internal spills, retry/cancellation and not-yet-visible source requests.
No early lease closure on failing/short R unless all promised R beats are drained or fabric reset guarantees termination; error is not a safe reuse certificate by itself.
After generation close, late walk responses cannot publish stale mapping or success into new owner. Actual access_ok is needed, not absence of a reported fault.
Do not release destination WRITE rights early; all held AW/W, issued writes and B/error responses remain owned. The source certificate cannot signal whole transfer success.
Same source physical page across SIDs/IOVAs needs all valid read leases accounted; cross-context alias directory cost or software unique-owner precondition must be explicit.
Mapping memory and payload cache coherence need the actual platform flush/barrier contract. RLAST at trusted DMA receipt proves data delivered, not arbitrary CPU global consistency for all accesses.
Old and new descriptor epochs cannot reuse a finite tag until all old request/results/certificates gone. Generation wrap is a forced slow-path drain.

ATS, remote/device-generated traffic, nested mapping replacement, MMIO, atomics and emergency revoke need separate semantics. Restricting first prototype is allowed, claiming general correctness is not.
No starvation guarantee under an indefinitely nonresponding device. Timeout can fault/isolate/reset, but cannot fabricate a successful retirement.

conditional_innovation_decision.rule_novelty: 因为PTX8.0已有源读取与全部COPY完成分离，rIOMMU已有ring隐式失效，ATC2015已有方向引用计数，DMAAUTH已有硬件权限门/身份变化，不能把这些原语或其简单串接直接宣称新发明。当前未检到完整多SID权限耗尽/复用合同并非首创证明。
conditional_innovation_decision.unique_system_benefit: 预排source-complete选择性撤销和freshIOVA+同一close合同复现208/340；因此不能声称复杂generation/调度相对该控制有独有收益。但它们已具备“可信源退休事件＋权限关闭”的新增接口，不能将此等价实现冒充准确发表前作，进而否决合同本身。
conditional_innovation_decision.engineering: 如果只允许可信有限单源区间COPY，接口可设计且本地能看见R/B事件；因为PR/PW未实现、描述符粒度源完成及epoch归属链不存在，需要真实微架构工作，不能当免费现成功能。
conditional_innovation_decision.advance_condition: 如果真实多SID共享IOMMU下，普通read-complete事件＋DMAAUTH式权限门＋范围排空仍因未完成事务、别名或授权/翻译缓存绑定造成一个具体可达障碍，而新合同能以可计成本消除这个障碍且完整强对照不能复现，准确前作也未覆盖，才可以把该新增合同/规则作为独立贡献。当前基本手例证明了源生命周期价值，但没有越过这一组合对照边界。
conditional_innovation_decision.stop_condition: 如果准确前作已有该源R退休驱动的独立权限/源复用合同，或者普通已有源完成API在相同保护语义和成本下直接满足，则这部分归为已有能力。若只有设想“给对照新增该合同”才能复现，应选择更简单实现而不是据此误判已有人做。

first_bounded_tasks: 协议表先列出全部生产场景：有限单区间、两个不连续源段、同页双SID读、最后R早于B、Rerror、heldAR＋revoke。每场景列首个有效请求承诺点、最后源访问证明和证书可发布条件。
root先核最近前作是否确实已有“最后源R退休⇒权限耗尽⇒源可复用”的独立合同，尤其设备completion语义、source-done DMA API、DMAAUTH/rIOMMU扩展。若无直接覆盖，再做可达性与成本模型；不要把新增同一合同的简单实现当成先例。
仅在差异成立时，模型5类决定场景：独立源与长B；同源跨SID；随机源回访；回收速率受限；错误/heldVALID关闭。输出全部COPY的完成、总吞吐、最坏V/A延迟、权限关闭到可复用界及新增状态。
未来实现入口为可信iDMA descriptor frontend/transport source completion、TC request cookie/response tracking、TL late-fill generation validation、CQ真正PR/PW。当前不修改文件，不建议先编完整bit。

positive_redesign_boundary.candidate_question: 能否对一个物理源页构造可组合的“授权未来访问集合为空”证明，使软件回收无需等待不相关SID/目的B，也无需每次遍历全部别名，而保留任意合法未完成COPY的进展？
positive_redesign_boundary.specific_action_to_design: 为每个有限源grant显式记录可继续产生的地址集合与已承诺R集合；close作用于未来集合，实际R退休消除已承诺集合。只有物理页全部grant的两个集合均为空才能出可复用证书。新旧代的持续写义务在另一集合中保存，不能混用completion。
positive_redesign_boundary.baseline_to_beat: 普通每alias活动/未完成计数＋PA反向索引已可完成简单情况；不能以“有引用计数”作独立贡献。要寻找与实际4DMA长度、乱序、共享方式相符的压缩/范围更新规则，在同信息同预算下降低别名遍历或状态成本。
positive_redesign_boundary.next_decisive_proof: 给出一个真实COPY序列，其未完成源集合可被候选规则压缩表示，而普通单前缀/每alias计数要么不安全要么过保守；再与完整精确按请求表比较，总状态与端到端节省必须均算清。若没有这样的具体差异，按现合同最简单实现作为工程能力归档。
positive_redesign_boundary.honest_status: 这是可证伪的后续机制问题，不是本轮已成立独有算法，也不要求为了保留候选而增加大模型/编译。
